senses.gloss: m.(b. h. קַרְדֹּם; קרדם, cmp. גַּרְדֵּם)cutting tool, spade, mattock, hatchet (with a pointed and a broad side).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:5">Ab. IV, 5</cite> <he>ולא ק׳ לחפור בהם</he> make not the words of the Law a spade to dig with them (the means for selfish ends).

<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:4">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 4</cite> <he>תוחב בשפוד ומכה בק׳ וכ׳</he> he sticks (into the ground where moles are suspected to hide) a spit, or strikes with a mattock and stamps the ground under him; Y. ib. I, 80ᶜ; Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>ואין … בק׳</he> (when splitting wood for immediate use on the Holy Day) you must not use the hatchet, expl.
<cite ref="Beitzah 31b:3">ib. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>נקבות שלו</he> the broad side of it.
<cite ref="Beitzah 31b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ וקופיץ</he> a tool combining axe and bill, v. <cite ref="S00508"><he>קוּפִּיץ</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Gittin 30b:5">Gitt. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מלא ק׳</he> a ground having room for the mattock to work in, a common-sized field, opp. to <he>מלא מחט</he> a diminutive patch of ground.—Pl. <he>קַרְדּוּמּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:1">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00937"><he>מַחֲרזוֹת</he></cite>; a. e.
